title: Using markets to adapt to climate change
Empirical approaches to climate change impact quantification
venue: Handbook of the Economics of Climate Change

title: Non-linear relationships between daily temperature extremes and US agricultural yields uncovered by global gridded meteorological datasets
abstract: Global agricultural commodity markets are highly integrated among major producers. Prices are driven by aggregate supply rather than what happens in individual countries in isolation. Estimating the effects of weather-induced shocks on production, trade patterns and prices hence requires a globally representative weather data set. Recently, two data sets that provide daily or hourly records, GMFD and ERA5-Land, became available. Starting with the US, a data rich region, we formally test whether these global data sets are as good as more fine-scaled country-specific data in explaining yields and whether they estimate similar response functions. While GMFD and ERA5-Land have lower predictive skill for US corn and soybeans yields than the fine-scaled PRISM data, they still correctly uncover the underlying non-linear temperature relationship. All specifications using daily temperature extremes under any of the weather data sets outperform models that use a quadratic in average temperature. Correctly capturing the effect of daily extremes has a larger effect than the choice of weather data. In a second step, focusing on Sub Saharan Africa, a data sparse region, we confirm that GMFD and ERA5-Land have superior predictive power to CRU, a global weather data set previously employed for modeling climate effects in the region.
abstract_zh: 全球农产品市场在主要生产国之间高度一体化。价格由总供给驱动，而非由单个国家孤立的情况决定。因此，估计天气冲击对生产、贸易格局和价格的影响，需要一套具有全球代表性的天气数据集。近来，提供逐日或逐小时记录的两套数据集GMFD和ERA5-Land问世。我们从数据丰富的美国入手，正式检验了这些全球数据集在解释单产方面是否与更精细的国别数据一样可靠，以及它们估计的响应函数是否相似。虽然对于美国玉米和大豆单产，GMFD和ERA5-Land的预测能力低于精细尺度的PRISM数据，但它们仍能正确揭示潜在的非线性温度关系。在任一天气数据集下，使用逐日极端温度的所有设定均优于使用平均温度二次项的模型。正确捕捉逐日极端值的效应，比天气数据的选择影响更大。第二步，我们聚焦于数据稀疏的撒哈拉以南非洲地区，证实GMFD和ERA5-Land的预测能力优于CRU（此前用于该地区气候效应建模的全球天气数据集）。

title: Future socio-ecosystem productivity threatened by compound drought–heatwave events
Declining crop yields limit the potential of bioenergy
Market Expectations of a Warming Climate
abstract: We compare prices of financial derivatives whose payouts are based on future weather outcomes to CMIP5 climate model predictions as well as observed weather station data across eight cities in the US from 2001 through 2020. Derivative prices respond both to short-term weather forecasts for the next two weeks and longer-term warming trends. We show that the long-term trends in derivative prices are comparable to station-level data and climate model output. The one exception is February in the northeastern US, where financial markets price in a polar vortex-induced cooling effect, a recent scientific finding that was not present in the older CMIP5 climate output. When looking at the spatial and temporal heterogeneity in trends, futures prices are more aligned with climate model output than observed weather station trends, suggesting that market participants closely align their expectations with scientific projections rather than recent observations.
abstract_zh: 我们将收益取决于未来天气结果的金融衍生品价格，与CMIP5气候模式预测以及2001至2020年间美国八个城市的观测气象站数据进行了比较。衍生品价格既对未来两周的短期天气预报做出反应，也对长期变暖趋势做出反应。我们表明，衍生品价格的长期趋势与站点级数据和气候模式输出具有可比性。唯一的例外是美国东北部的二月份，金融市场将极地涡旋引起的降温效应计入价格，这是一项较新的科学发现，并未出现在较早的CMIP5气候输出中。在考察趋势的空间和时间异质性时，期货价格与气候模式输出的吻合程度高于与观测气象站趋势的吻合程度，这表明市场参与者更倾向于使自身预期与科学预测保持一致，而非与近期观测结果保持一致。

title: Quantifying the Impacts of Compound Extremes on Agriculture
abstract:
Agricultural production and food prices are affected by
hydroclimatic extremes. There has been a growing amount of literature measuring the impacts of individual extreme events (heat stress or water stress) on agricultural and human systems. Yet, we lack a comprehensive understanding of the significance and the magnitude of the impacts of compound extremes. This study combines a fine-scale weather product with outputs of a hydrological model to construct functional metrics of individual and compound hydroclimatic extremes for agriculture. Then, a yield response function is estimated with individual and compound metrics, focusing on corn in the United States during the 1981–2015 period. Supported by statistical evidence, the findings suggest that metrics of compound hydroclimatic extremes are better predictors of corn yield variations than metrics of individual extremes. The results also confirm that wet heat is more damaging than dry heat for corn. This study shows the average yield damage from heat stress has been up to four times more severe when combined with water stress.
abstract_zh: 农业生产和粮食价格受到水文气候极端事件的影响。关于单一极端事件（热胁迫或水分胁迫）对农业和人类系统影响的文献日益增多。然而，我们对复合极端事件的重要性和影响程度缺乏全面的认识。本研究结合了精细尺度的天气产品与水文模型的输出，构建了农业领域单一及复合水文气候极端事件的功能性指标。随后，以1981—2015年美国玉米为对象，利用单一及复合指标估计了单产响应函数。统计证据表明，复合水文气候极端指标比单一极端指标更能预测玉米单产的变化。结果还证实，湿热对玉米的损害大于干热。本研究表明，热胁迫与水分胁迫叠加时，热胁迫造成的平均单产损失可高达其单独作用时的四倍。

title: Violent conflict exacerbated drought-related food insecurity between 2009 and 2019 in sub-Saharan Africa
abstract: Conflict, drought and locusts are leading concerns for African food security but the relative importance and spatiotemporal scale of crises resulting from each hazard is poorly characterized. Here we use continuous, subnational data to demonstrate that the rise of food insecurity across sub-Saharan Africa that began in 2014 is attributable to an increase in violent conflict, particularly in South Sudan and Nigeria. Although drought remains a leading trigger of food crises, the prevalence of drought-related crises did not increase from 2009 to 2018. When exposed to drought, pastoralists experienced more widespread, severe and long-lasting food crises than people living in agricultural zones. Food insecurity remained elevated in pastoral regions for 2 years following a drought, while agricultural regions returned to pre-drought food-security levels in ~12 months. The few confirmed famines during the 2009–2018 period coincided with both conflict and drought, while locusts had little effect on food security during this period.
abstract_zh: 冲突、干旱和蝗灾是非洲粮食安全的主要隐忧，但每种灾害所引发危机的相对重要性及其时空尺度尚缺乏充分刻画。本文利用连续的次国家级数据表明，始于2014年的撒哈拉以南非洲粮食不安全加剧，可归因于暴力冲突的增加，尤其是在南苏丹和尼日利亚。尽管干旱仍是粮食危机的主要诱因之一，但2009至2018年间与干旱相关的危机发生率并未上升。遭遇干旱时，牧民所经历的粮食危机比生活在农业地区的人群更为广泛、严重且持续时间更长。干旱之后，牧区的粮食不安全状况在两年内仍居高不下，而农业地区大约在12个月内便恢复到干旱前的粮食安全水平。2009–2018年间得到确认的少数饥荒，与冲突和干旱同时出现，而蝗灾在此期间对粮食安全的影响很小。

title: Environmental Drivers of Agricultural Productivity Growth and Socioeconomic Spillovers
venue: Federal Reserve Bank of Kansas City's Agricultural Symposium

title: The Effects of Extreme Weather on Apple Quality
abstract: A large literature has documented the effects of weather on agricultural yields. However, weather not only impacts the quantity produced, but also the quality of the product. Due to data limitations, the quality effects have primarily been studied using lab experiments for specific attributes, and the financial implications for farmers of a quality effect are less clear. Using a unique longitudinal micro-level data set of Swiss apple orchards that include information on both the quantity produced as well as the quality, we show that the latter can have an even larger effect on farm revenue. Ignoring the quality of the harvested product substantially biases the impact of weather extremes on agricultural income and the potential effects of climate change. Our quality measure is the orchard-year specific price shock. If an orchard gets a lower price for its specific apple variety compared to previous years and compared to other orchards in the same year, we observe the market’s valuation of its inferior quality accounting for overall price movements (other orchards growing same variety that year) as well as orchard specific factors (orchard fixed effects). We find that spring frost events induce farm gate price drops and thus revenue reductions of up to 2.05% per hour of exposure.
abstract_zh: 大量文献记录了天气对农业单产的影响。然而，天气不仅影响产量，也影响产品质量。由于数据限制，质量效应主要通过针对特定属性的实验室实验进行研究，而质量效应对农民财务的影响尚不清楚。利用瑞士苹果园独特的纵向微观数据集（既包括产量信息，也包括质量信息），我们表明，质量效应对农场收入的影响可能更大。忽视收获产品的质量，会严重偏误天气极端事件对农业收入的影响，以及气候变化的潜在效应。我们的质量指标是果园—年份特定的价格冲击。若某果园的特定苹果品种价格，相较于前几年及同年其他果园而言较低，则在考虑整体价格变动（同年种植相同品种的其他果园）以及果园特定因素（果园固定效应）后，我们可以观察到市场对其劣质的估值。我们发现，春季霜冻事件导致农场门口价格下降，进而收入减少，每小时暴露最多可达2.05%。

title: Estimating global agricultural effects of geoengineering using volcanic eruptions
Asylum Applications and Migration Flows
venue: American Economic Review - Papers and Proceedings

title: Asylum applications respond to temperature fluctuations
abstract: International negotiations on climate change, along with recent upsurges in migration across the Mediterranean Sea, have highlighted the need to better understand the possible effects of climate change on human migration-in particular, across national borders. Here we examine how, in the recent past (2000-2014), weather variations in 103 source countries translated into asylum applications to the European Union, which averaged 351,000 per year in our sample. We find that temperatures that deviated from the moderate optimum (~20°C) increased asylum applications in a nonlinear fashion, which implies an accelerated increase under continued future warming. Holding everything else constant, asylum applications by the end of the century are predicted to increase, on average, by 28% (98,000 additional asylum applications per year) under representative concentration pathway (RCP) scenario 4.5 and by 188% (660,000 additional applications per year) under RCP 8.5 for the 21 climate models in the NASA Earth Exchange Global Daily Downscaled Projections (NEX-GDDP).
abstract_zh: 气候变化的国际谈判以及近期地中海沿岸移民激增，凸显了更好理解气候变化对人口迁移（尤其是跨国界迁移）可能影响的必要性。在此，我们考察了近期（2000—2014年）103个来源国的天气变化如何转化为欧盟的庇护申请，样本中年均申请量为351,000件。我们发现，偏离适宜温度（约20°C）的气温以非线性方式增加了庇护申请，这意味着在未来持续变暖的情况下，增长将加速。在其他条件不变的情况下，预计到本世纪末，在代表性浓度路径（RCP）4.5情景下，庇护申请平均将增加28%（每年新增98,000件）；在RCP 8.5情景下将增加188%（每年新增660,000件）。该预测基于NASA地球交换全球逐日降尺度预估（NEX-GDDP）中的21个气候模式。

title: Comparing and combining process-based crop models and statistical models with some implications for climate change
Consistent negative response of US crops to high temperatures in observations and crop models
abstract:
High temperatures are detrimental to crop yields and could lead to global warming-driven reductions in agricultural productivity. To assess future threats, the majority of studies used process-based crop models, but their ability to represent effects of high temperature has been questioned. Here we show that an ensemble of nine crop models reproduces the observed average temperature responses of US maize, soybean and wheat yields. Each day >30 °C diminishes maize and soybean yields by up to 6% under rainfed conditions. Declines observed in irrigated areas, or simulated assuming full irrigation, are weak. This supports the hypothesis that water stress induced by high temperatures causes the decline. For wheat a negative response to high temperature is neither observed nor simulated under historical conditions, since critical temperatures are rarely exceeded during the growing season. In the future, yields are modelled to decline for all three crops at temperatures >30 °C. Elevated CO
2
can only weakly reduce these yield losses, in contrast to irrigation.
abstract_zh: 高温不利于作物单产，并可能导致全球变暖引起的农业生产力下降。为评估未来威胁，大多数研究使用基于过程的作物模型，但其刻画高温效应的能力一直受到质疑。在此，我们表明，由九个作物模型组成的集合再现了美国玉米、大豆和小麦单产观测到的平均温度响应。每天温度超过30°C，雨养条件下玉米和大豆单产最多降低6%。在灌溉地区观察到的或在完全灌溉假设下模拟的减产则较弱。这支持了高温引发的水分胁迫导致减产的假说。对于小麦，在历史条件下既未观察到也未模拟出对高温的负向响应，因为生长季中很少超过临界温度。未来，模型显示三种作物在温度超过30°C时单产均将下降。相比灌溉，升高的CO₂只能较微弱地减轻这些产量损失。

title: The Use of Panel Models in Assessments of Climate Impacts on Agriculture
venue: Review of Environmental Economics and Policy
abstract: Assessments of climate change impacts on agriculture are increasingly relying on panel models to examine the relationship between agricultural outcomes and weather fluctuations. This article reviews the strengths and weaknesses of such models. We argue that panel models are ideal for assessing climate impacts on agriculture because they use group fixed effects to absorb all time-invariant variation and thus rely on weather deviations from the mean that are random and exogenous. Using this random and exogenous source of variation is crucial to identifying a causal relationship between agricultural outcomes and weather. In addition, the large number of observations offered by a panel data set allows the identification of a nonlinear response function, which is an important step in modeling the effects of climate change, as the response can be highly nonlinear. Despite these strengths of panel models, they may still suffer from omitted variable biases of time-varying variables, such as pollution shocks, which are correlated with the weather shocks. Moreover, because group fixed effects absorb a lot of the signal in the weather variables, the signal:noise ratio might decrease. Thus researchers should be careful when constructing the weather variables in order to avoid having noise in the data that causes downward biases in the coefficients.
abstract_zh: 气候变化对农业影响的评估日益依赖面板模型，以考察农业产出与天气波动之间的关系。本文回顾了此类模型的优势与不足。我们认为，面板模型是评估气候对农业影响的理想工具，因为它们利用群组固定效应吸收了所有不随时间变化的变异，从而依赖于随机且外生的、偏离均值的天气变化。利用这一随机且外生的变异来源，对于识别农业产出与天气之间的因果关系至关重要。此外，面板数据集提供的大量观测值，使得识别非线性响应函数成为可能，这是模拟气候变化效应的重要一步，因为响应可能高度非线性。尽管面板模型具有这些优势，它们仍可能受到时变变量遗漏变量偏误的影响，例如与天气冲击相关的污染冲击。此外，由于群组固定效应吸收了天气变量中的大量信号，信噪比可能下降。因此，研究者在构建天气变量时应当谨慎，以避免数据中存在导致系数向下偏误的噪声。

title: Airports, Air Pollution, and Contemporaneous Health
abstract: Airports are some of the largest sources of air pollution in the United States. We demonstrate that daily airport runway congestion contributes significantly to local pollution levels and contemporaneous health of residents living nearby and downwind from airports. Our research design exploits the fact that network delays originating from large airports on the East Coast increase runway congestion in California, which in turn increases daily pollution levels around California airports. Using the component of California air pollution driven by airport congestion, we find that carbon monoxide (CO) leads to significant increases in hospitalization rates for asthma, respiratory, and heart related emergency room admissions that are an order of magnitude larger than conventional estimates: A one standard deviation increase in daily pollution levels leads to an additional $1 million in hospitalization costs for respiratory and heart related admissions for the 6 million individuals living within 10km (6.2 miles) of the 12 largest airports in California. While infants and the elderly are more sensitive to air pollution, we also find significant relationships for the adult population. The health impacts are driven by CO, not NO2 or O3, and occur at levels far below existing EPA mandates. Our results suggest there may be sizable morbidity benefits from lowering the existing CO standard.
abstract_zh: 机场是美国最大的空气污染源之一。我们证明，机场每日的跑道拥堵显著加剧了当地的污染水平，并影响了居住在机场附近及其下风向居民的同期健康状况。我们的研究设计利用了这样一个事实：源自美国东海岸大型机场的网络延误，会增加加利福尼亚州的跑道拥堵，进而提高加州机场周边的每日污染水平。利用由机场拥堵所驱动的那部分加州空气污染，我们发现一氧化碳（CO）会导致哮喘、呼吸系统和心脏相关的急诊入院率显著上升，其幅度比传统估计大一个数量级：对于居住在加州12个最大机场10公里（6.2英里）范围内的600万人口而言，每日污染水平增加一个标准差，将额外导致呼吸和心脏相关入院产生100万美元的住院费用。尽管婴儿和老年人对空气污染更为敏感，我们在成年人口中也发现了显著的关系。健康影响由一氧化碳驱动，而非二氧化氮或臭氧，并且发生在远低于现行美国环境保护署标准的水平上。我们的结果表明，降低现行一氧化碳标准可能带来相当可观的发病率效益。

title: Balancing economic and ecological goals
Recent weather fluctuations and agricultural yields: implications for climate change
venue: Agricultural Economics - Plenary Session of the Triannual International Conference of Agricultural Economists
abstract: We summarize recent statistical analyses that link agricultural yields to weather fluctuations. Similar to other sectors, high temperatures play a crucial role in predicting outcomes. Climate change is predicted to significantly increase high temperatures and thereby reduce yields. How good are such models at predicting future outcomes? We show that a statistical model estimated using historic US data on corn and soybean yields from 1950 to 2011 is very capable of predicting aggregate US yields for the years 2012–2015, where 2012 was much hotter than normal and is expected to become the new normal under climate change. We conclude by discussing recent studies on the implication of predicted yield declines with a special focus on adaptation and commodity prices.
abstract_zh: 我们总结了近期将农业单产与天气波动联系起来的统计分析。与其他部门类似，高温在预测结果中发挥着关键作用。预计气候变化将显著增加高温，从而降低单产。此类模型在预测未来结果方面表现如何？我们表明，利用1950至2011年美国玉米和大豆单产历史数据估计的统计模型，能够很好地预测2012—2015年美国总单产，其中2012年比常年炎热得多，并且预计在气候变化下将成为新常态。最后，我们讨论了近期关于单产下降预测影响的研究，特别关注适应性和商品价格。

title: Federal Crop Insurance and the Disincentive to Adapt to Extreme Heat
venue: American Economic Review - Papers and Proceedings
abstract: Despite significant progress in average yields, the sensitivity of corn and soybean yields to extreme heat has remained relatively constant over time. We combine county-level corn and soybeans yields in the United States from 1989-2013 with the fraction of the planting area that is insured under the federal crop insurance program, which expanded greatly over this time period as premium subsidies increased from 20 percent to 60 percent. Insured corn and soybeans are significantly more sensitive to extreme heat that uninsured crops. Insured farmers do not have the incentive to engage in costly adaptation as insurance compensates them for potential losses.
abstract_zh: 尽管平均单产取得了显著进展，玉米和大豆单产对极端高温的敏感性在这一时期基本保持不变。我们将1989—2013年美国县级玉米和大豆单产，与参加联邦作物保险计划的种植面积比例相结合。在此期间，随着保费补贴从20%增加到60%，该计划大幅扩展。参保的玉米和大豆对极端高温的敏感性显著高于未参保作物。参保农民没有进行代价高昂的适应性调整的激励，因为保险会对其潜在损失进行补偿。

title: The effects of extremely wet planting conditions on maize and soybean yields
Corn Production Shocks in 2012 and Beyond: Implications for Harvest Volatility
venue: NBER Conference: The Economics of Food Price Volatility

title: Empirical studies on agricultural impacts and adaptation
Greater Sensitivity to Drought Accompanies Maize Yield Increase in the U.S. Midwest
abstract:
The U.S. Corn Belt accounts for a sizeable portion of the world's maize growth. Various influences have increased yields over the years.
Lobell
et al.
(p.
516
; see the Perspective by
Ort and Long
) now show that sensitivity to drought has been increasing as well. It seems that as plants have been bred for increased yield under ideal conditions, the plants become more sensitive to non-ideal conditions. A key factor may be the planting density. Although today's maize varieties are more robust to crowding and the farmer can get more plants in per field, this same crowding takes a toll when water resources are limited.
abstract_zh: 美国玉米带占世界玉米产量的相当大份额。多种因素使单产逐年提高。Lobell等人（第516页；参见Ort和Long的展望文章）现在表明，对干旱的敏感性也在增加。似乎随着植株被培育以在理想条件下获得更高产量，它们对非理想条件变得更加敏感。一个关键因素可能是种植密度。尽管当今的玉米品种对密植更具耐受性，农民也能在每块田地中种植更多植株，但当水资源有限时，这种密植同样会带来负面影响。

title: Agronomic Weather Measures in Econometric Models of Crop Yield with Implications for Climate Change
Identifying Supply and Demand Elasticities of Agricultural Commodities: Implications for the US Ethanol Mandate
abstract: We present a new framework to identify supply elasticities of storable commodities where past shocks are used as exogenous price shifters. In the agricultural context, past yield shocks change inventory levels and futures prices of agricultural commodities. We use our estimated elasticities to evaluate the impact of the 2009 Renewable Fuel Standard on commodity prices, quantities, and food consumers' surplus for the four basic staples: corn, rice, soybeans, and wheat. Prices increase 20 percent if one-third of commodities used to produce ethanol are recycled as feedstock, with a positively skewed 95 percent confidence interval that ranges from 14 to 35 percent. (JEL Q11, Q16, Q42, Q48)
abstract_zh: 我们提出了一个新框架，用于识别可储存商品的供给弹性，其中过去的冲击被用作外生价格移动变量。在农业背景下，过去的单产冲击会改变农产品的库存水平和期货价格。我们利用估计的弹性评估了2009年《可再生燃料标准》对四种基本主粮（玉米、大米、大豆和小麦）价格、产量以及食品消费者剩余的影响。若用于生产乙醇的商品中有三分之一被回用为原料，价格将上涨20%，其95%置信区间呈正偏态，范围为14%至35%。（JEL Q11, Q16, Q42, Q48）

title: Something in the Water: Contaminated Drinking Water and Infant Health
abstract: This paper provides estimates of the effects of in utero exposure to contaminated drinking water on fetal health. To do this, we examine the universe of birth records and drinking water testing results for the state of New Jersey from 1997 to 2007. Our data enable us to compare outcomes across siblings who were potentially exposed to differing levels of harmful contaminants from drinking water while in utero. We find small effects of drinking water contamination on all children, but large and statistically significant effects on birth weight and gestation of infants born to less educated mothers. We also show that those mothers who were most affected by contamination were the least likely to move between births in response to contamination.
abstract_zh: 本文估计了子宫内暴露于受污染饮用水对胎儿健康的影响。为此，我们考察了1997至2007年间新泽西州全部的出生记录以及饮用水检测结果。我们的数据使我们能够比较在子宫内可能暴露于不同水平有害饮用水污染物的兄弟姐妹之间的结局。我们发现，饮用水污染对所有儿童的影响较小，但对受教育程度较低的母亲所生婴儿的出生体重和孕周有较大且具有统计显著性的影响。我们还表明，受污染影响最大的母亲，在两次分娩之间因污染而迁居的可能性最小。

title: The critical role of extreme heat for maize production in the United States
US maize adaptability
Using Weather Data and Climate Model Output in Economic Analyses of Climate Change
venue: Review of Environmental Economics and Policy
abstract: Economists are increasingly using weather data and climate model output in analyses of the economic impacts of climate change. This article introduces weather data sets and climate models that are frequently used, discusses the most common mistakes economists make in using these products, and identifies ways to avoid these pitfalls. We first provide an introduction to weather data, including a summary of the types of data sets available, and then we discuss five common pitfalls that empirical researchers should be aware of when using historical weather data as explanatory variables in econometric applications. We then provide a brief overview of climate models and discuss two common and significant errors often made by economists when climate model output is used to simulate the future impacts of climate change on an economic outcome of interest.
abstract_zh: 经济学家在分析气候变化的经济影响时，越来越多地使用天气数据和气候模式输出。本文介绍了常用的天气数据集和气候模式，讨论了经济学家在使用这些产品时最常犯的错误，并提出了规避这些陷阱的方法。我们首先介绍天气数据，包括对可用数据集类型的概述，然后讨论实证研究者在将历史天气数据作为计量经济学应用中的解释变量时应当注意的五个常见陷阱。随后，我们简要概述气候模式，并讨论经济学家在使用气候模式输出模拟气候变化对其关注的经济结果的未来影响时，常犯的两类重要错误。

title: Is Agricultural Production Becoming More or Less Sensitive to Extreme Heat? Evidence from U.S. Corn and Soybean Yields
venue: NBER Conference: The Design and Implementation of U.S. Climate Policy
abstract: Extreme heat is the single best predictor of corn and soybean yields in the United States. While average yields have risen continuously since World War II, we find no evidence that relative tolerance to extreme heat has improved between 1950 and 2005.Climate change forecasts project a sharp increase in extreme heat by the end of the century, with the potential to significantly reduce yields under current technologies.
abstract_zh: 极端高温是美国玉米和大豆单产的唯一最佳预测因子。虽然二战以来平均单产持续上升，但我们没有发现证据表明，1950至2005年间对极端高温的相对耐受性有所提高。气候变化预测显示，到本世纪末极端高温将急剧增加，在当前技术条件下，这可能显著降低单产。

title: Projected Temperature Changes Indicate Significant Increase in Interannual Variability of U.S. Maize Yields
The Economic Impacts of Climate Change: Evidence from Agricultural Output and Random Fluctuations in Weather: Comment
abstract: Fisher et al. (2012)––henceforth, FHRS––have uncovered coding and data errors in our paper, Deschênes and Greenstone (2007), henceforth, DG. We acknowledge and are embarrassed by these mistakes. We are grateful to FHRS for uncovering them. We hope that this Reply will also contribute to advancing the literature on the vital question of the impact of climate change on the US agricultural sector.
abstract_zh: Fisher等人（2012）——以下简称FHRS——发现了我们在Deschênes和Greenstone（2007）一文（以下简称DG）中的编码和数据错误。我们承认这些错误，并对此深感惭愧。我们感谢FHRS发现了这些错误。我们希望本回复也能推动关于气候变化对美国农业部门影响这一重要问题的文献研究。

title: Climate Trends and Global Crop Production Since 1980
abstract: Efforts to anticipate how climate change will affect future food availability can benefit from understanding the impacts of changes to date. We found that in the cropping regions and growing seasons of most countries, with the important exception of the United States, temperature trends from 1980 to 2008 exceeded one standard deviation of historic year-to-year variability. Models that link yields of the four largest commodity crops to weather indicate that global maize and wheat production declined by 3.8 and 5.5%, respectively, relative to a counterfactual without climate trends. For soybeans and rice, winners and losers largely balanced out. Climate trends were large enough in some countries to offset a significant portion of the increases in average yields that arose from technology, carbon dioxide fertilization, and other factors.
abstract_zh: 要预测气候变化将如何影响未来的粮食供应，有必要理解迄今为止已产生的影响。我们发现，除美国这一重要例外外，在大多数国家的种植区和生长季中，1980至2008年的气温趋势已超过历史逐年变率的一个标准差。通过将四种主要商品作物的单产与天气联系起来的模型表明，相对于没有气候趋势的反事实情形，全球玉米和小麦产量分别下降了3.8%和5.5%。对于大豆和大米，赢家与输家大体相抵。在某些国家，气候趋势的规模大到足以抵消技术、二氧化碳施肥及其他因素带来的平均单产增长中的相当一部分。

title: Optimal Management of an Ecosystem With an Unknown Threshold
abstract: We consider an ecosystem with two distinct equations of motion that are separated by a threshold value of the state variable. We find that increasing uncertainty (both uncertainty embedded in the natural system and uncertainty of the decisionmaker about the location of the threshold) can lead to nonmonotonic changes in precaution: a reduction in uncertainty can first increase and then decrease optimal precautionary activity. This nonmonotonicity can help to explain why regulators often give conflicting arguments about optimal abatement policies in the face of uncertainty. For example, some regulators argue for an immediate reduction in pollutant loading until uncertainty about the underlying process is reduced while others call for no costly reductions in pollutant loading until the same uncertainty is reduced. These statements can be consistent even if both sides agree on both economic objectives and the system dynamics, but have different priors on the uncertainty involved.
abstract_zh: 我们考虑一个生态系统，其两个不同的运动方程由状态变量的阈值分隔。我们发现，不确定性的增加（包括自然系统内蕴的不确定性，以及决策者对阈值位置的不确定性）可能导致预防行为的非单调变化：不确定性的降低可能先增加、后减少最优的预防性活动。这种非单调性有助于解释，为何在面对不确定性时，监管者对最优减排政策常常给出相互冲突的论点。例如，一些监管者主张在对基础过程的不确定性降低之前，立即减少污染物排放；而另一些人则主张在同样的不确定性降低之前，不进行代价高昂的污染物排放削减。即使双方在经济目标和系统动态上达成一致，只是对所涉不确定性持有不同先验，这些说法也可以同时成立。

title: Water Quality Violations and Avoidance Behavior: Evidence from Bottled Water Consumption
venue: American Economic Review: Papers and Proceedings

title: Robust Negative Impacts of Climate Change on African Agriculture
abstract: There is widespread interest in the impacts of climate change on agriculture in Sub-Saharan Africa (SSA), and on the most effective investments to assist adaptation to these changes, yet the scientific basis for estimating production risks and prioritizing investments has been quite limited. Here we show that by combining historical crop production and weather data into a panel analysis, a robust model of yield response to climate change emerges for several key African crops. By mid-century, the mean estimates of aggregate production changes in SSA under our preferred model specification are -22, -17, -17, -18, and -8% for maize, sorghum, millet, groundnut, and cassava, respectively. In all cases except cassava, there is a 95% probability that damages exceed 7%, and a 5% probability that they exceed 27%.Moreover, countries with the highest average yields have the largest projected yield losses, suggesting that well-fertilized modern seed varieties are more susceptible to heat related losses.
abstract_zh: 人们广泛关注气候变化对撒哈拉以南非洲（SSA）农业的影响，以及为帮助适应这些变化而最有效的投资，然而，估计生产风险并确定投资优先级的科学基础一直相当有限。在此，我们表明，通过将历史作物产量与天气数据结合进行面板分析，可以为若干关键非洲作物得出稳健的单产气候变化响应模型。到本世纪中叶，在我们偏好的模型设定下，SSA总产量变化的平均估计值，玉米为-22%，高粱为-17%，小米为-17%，花生为-18%，木薯为-8%。除木薯外，在所有情形下，损失超过7%的概率为95%，超过27%的概率为5%。此外，平均单产最高的国家预计产量损失最大，这表明施肥充足的现代种子品种更易受到与高温相关的损失影响。

title: The Evolution of Heat Tolerance of Corn: Implications for Climate Change
venue: NBER Conference: The Economics of Climate Change: Adaptations Past and Present
abstract: This chapter analyzes the technological change in seed types in response to climatic shocks. New evidence on the relationship between weather and corn yields by assembling data from 1901 to 2005 for Indiana, a major corn producing state, on yields, the daily temperature range between minimum and maximum temperature and precipitation are looked upon. Crop sensitivity to extremes in temperature and precipitation evolved over time as new seed varieties, supple mental irrigation, and new production and management techniques were introduced. The evolution of tolerance for excessive heat has been less successful than that for swings in precipitation. Improvements in heat tolerance have been nonlinear, growing with the introduction of new double-cross hybrids in the 1940s and 1950s, peaking in 1960, and then declining after the introduction of single-cross hybrid corn. The key question is whether the next seed innovation cycle can bring both increases in average yields and heat tolerance. There may be little scope for response to higher temperatures while maintaining yields in areas where corn is currently grown as all climate models predict significant increases in extreme heat in these areas.
abstract_zh: 本章分析了种子品种为应对气候冲击而发生的技术变化。通过汇集1901至2005年印第安纳州（美国主要玉米产区）的数据，我们提供了关于天气与玉米单产之间关系的新证据，所考察的数据包括单产、最低与最高气温之间的日温差以及降水。随着新种子品种、补充灌溉以及新的生产和管理技术的引入，作物对温度和降水极端值的敏感性随时间演变。对过量高温的耐受性演变，远不如对降水波动的耐受性演变成功。耐热性的改善是非线性的：随着20世纪40和50年代新型双杂交种的引入而增长，在1960年达到峰值，随后在单交种玉米引入后下降。关键问题在于，下一轮种子创新周期能否同时带来平均单产的提高和耐热性的增强。在当前种植玉米的地区，由于所有气候模式都预测这些地区的极端高温将显著增加，在维持单产的同时应对更高温度的空间可能非常有限。

title: Consumer and Market Responses to Mad-Cow Disease
Fisheries Management under Cyclical Population Dynamics
abstract: Cycles in environmental conditions (e.g., sea-surface temperature) directly impact fish growth. This paper extends the classical Gordon-Schaefer fishery model by replacing the constant growth rate with a cyclical growth rate. The optimal harvest rate is shown to fluctuate, but the cycle of the harvest rate lags the cycle of the biological growth function with the highest harvest rate occurring after biological conditions start to decline. Simulations contrast various fishing policies and illustrate the proclivity to crash a fishery if it is wrongfully managed as if there is a constant growth rate with i.i.d. environmental shocks. Finally, we show that small cyclical fluctuations in one species can result in large fluctuations in the optimal harvest rate of another species if the fish species are interlinked through predator-prey relationships.
abstract_zh: 环境条件的周期性变化（例如海表温度）会直接影响鱼类生长。本文对经典的戈登—谢弗渔业模型进行了扩展，以周期性生长率取代恒定生长率。研究表明，最优捕捞率会出现波动，但捕捞率的周期滞后于生物生长函数的周期，捕捞率最高的时期出现在生物条件开始下降之后。模拟比较了多种捕捞政策，并说明了如果将渔业错误地当作具有恒定增长率且存在独立同分布环境冲击的情形来管理，其崩溃的可能性会很大。最后，我们表明，如果两种鱼类通过捕食者—猎物关系相互关联，那么一个物种的微小周期性波动，可能会导致另一个物种的最优捕捞率出现较大幅度的波动。

title: Nonlinear Temperature Effects indicate Severe Damages to U.S. Crop Yields under Climate Change
venue: Proceedings of the National Academy of Sciences
abstract: The United States produces 41% of the world's corn and 38% of the world's soybeans. These crops comprise two of the four largest sources of caloric energy produced and are thus critical for world food supply. We pair a panel of county-level yields for these two crops, plus cotton (a warmer-weather crop), with a new fine-scale weather dataset that incorporates the whole distribution of temperatures within each day and across all days in the growing season. We find that yields increase with temperature up to 29° C for corn, 30° C for soybeans, and 32° C for cotton but that temperatures above these thresholds are very harmful. The slope of the decline above the optimum is significantly steeper than the incline below it. The same nonlinear and asymmetric relationship is found when we isolate either time-series or cross-sectional variations in temperatures and yields. This suggests limited historical adaptation of seed varieties or management practices to warmer temperatures because the cross-section includes farmers' adaptations to warmer climates and the time-series does not. Holding current growing regions fixed, area-weighted average yields are predicted to decrease by 30–46% before the end of the century under the slowest (B1) warming scenario and decrease by 63–82% under the most rapid warming scenario (A1FI) under the Hadley III model.
abstract_zh: 美国生产世界41%的玉米和38%的大豆。这两种作物是全球生产的两大热量能源来源之一，因此对世界粮食供应至关重要。我们将这两种作物以及棉花（一种更耐温暖的作物）的县级单产面板，与一套新的精细尺度天气数据集相结合，该数据集涵盖了每日内以及生长季所有日期内的完整温度分布。我们发现，玉米单产在温度升至29°C之前随温度上升，大豆为30°C，棉花为32°C，但超过这些阈值的温度则极为有害。高于最适温度后的下降斜率显著陡于低于最适温度时的上升斜率。当我们分别分离时间序列变异或截面变异时，同样发现了这种非线性和不对称关系。这表明历史上种子品种或管理措施对更温暖气温的适应有限，因为截面数据包含了农民对温暖气候的适应，而时间序列数据则不包含。将当前种植区固定不变，在最慢的（B1）变暖情景下，到本世纪末区域加权平均单产预计下降30%—46%；在最快的（A1FI）变暖情景下，依据Hadley III模型，预计下降63%—82%。

title: Reduced Form versus Structural Modeling in Environmental and Resource Economics
abstract: We contrast structural and reduced form empirical studies in environmental and resource economics. Both methodologies have their own context-specific advantages and disadvantages, and should be viewed as complements, not substitutes. Structural models typically require a theoretical model and explicit assumptions about structural errors in order to recover the parameters of behavioral functions. These estimates may be required to measure general equilibrium welfare effects or to simulate intricate feedback loops between natural and economic processes. However, many of the assumptions used to recover structural estimates are untestable. The goal of reduced form studies is, conversely, to recover key parameters of interest using exogenous within-sample variation with as few structural assumptions as possible—reducing reliance on these assumptions assists in establishing causality in the relationship of interest. Reduced-form studies do, however, require assumptions of their own, e.g., the (quasi) randomness of an experiment with no spillover effects on the control group.
abstract_zh: 我们对比了环境与资源经济学中的结构式与简化式实证研究。两种方法各有其情境相关的优缺点，应被视为互补而非替代。结构模型通常需要理论模型，并对结构误差做出明确假设，才能恢复行为函数的参数。这些估计对于衡量一般均衡福利效应，或模拟自然过程与经济过程之间复杂的反馈循环，可能是必要的。然而，用于恢复结构估计的许多假设是不可检验的。相反，简化式研究的目标是利用样本内的外生变异，在尽可能少的结构假设下恢复关键的感兴趣参数——减少对这些假设的依赖，有助于确立所关注关系中的因果性。不过，简化式研究也需要其自身的假设，例如，一项对照组不受溢出效应影响的实验，其（准）随机性。

title: World Supply and Demand of Food Commodity Calories
Sustainable Fisheries
Water Availability, Degree Days, and the Potential Impact of Climate Change on Irrigated Agriculture in California
Nonlinear Effects of Weather on Corn Yields
abstract: This paper examines the reduced-form relationship between weather and yields using a unique data set of maize yields and daily weather records covering the eastern USA for 1950-2004. Since weather variations in a fixed location are exogenous and random, the reduced-form relationship constitutes a viable natural experiment and is therefore clearly identified. The study finds a significant nonlinear relationship between temperature and maize yields that is roughly in line with the concept of degree days: yields increase with temperature at moderate temperatures (between 12°C and 25°C), but rapidly become negative at temperatures in excess of 30°C.
abstract_zh: 本文利用1950—2004年覆盖美国东部的玉米单产和逐日天气记录这一独特数据集，考察了天气与单产之间的简化式关系。由于固定地点的天气变化是外生且随机的，简化式关系构成了一个可行的自然实验，因而得到明确识别。研究发现，温度与玉米单产之间存在显著的非线性关系，大致符合度日（degree days）的概念：在温和温度（12°C至25°C之间）下，单产随温度上升而增加，但当温度超过30°C时则迅速变为负值。

title: The Impact of Global Warming on U.S. Agriculture: An Econometric Analysis of Optimal Growing Conditions
abstract: We link farmland values to climatic, soil, and socioeconomic variables for U.S. counties east of the 100th meridian, the historical boundary of agriculture not primarily dependent on irrigation. Degree days, a nonlinear transformation of the climatic variables suggested by agronomic experiments as more relevant to crop yield, gives an improved fit and increased robustness. Estimated coefficients are consistent with the experimental results. The model is employed to estimate the potential impacts on farmland values for a range of recent warming scenarios. The predictions are very robust, and more than 75% of the counties in our sample show a statistically significant effect, ranging from moderate gains to large losses, with losses in the aggregate that can become quite large under scenarios involving sustained heavy use of fossil fuels.
abstract_zh: 我们将农田价格与美国第100经线以东县的气候、土壤和社会经济变量联系起来。第100经线是历史上不主要依赖灌溉的农业边界。度日是依据农学实验认为与作物单产更相关的、对气候变量的非线性变换，它使拟合效果更好且更稳健。估计系数与实验结果一致。该模型被用于估计一系列近期变暖情景下对农田价格的潜在影响。预测结果非常稳健，我们样本中超过75%的县显示出统计显著的效应，从温和收益到大幅损失不等，且在持续大量使用化石燃料的情景下，总体损失可能相当巨大。

title: Will U.S. Agriculture Really Benefit from Global Warming? Accounting for Irrigation in the Hedonic Approach
Climate Change, Crop Yields, and Internal Migration in the United States
abstract: We investigate the link between agricultural productivity and net migration in the United States using a county-level panel for the most recent period of 1970-2009.In rural counties of the Corn Belt, we find a statistically significant relationship between changes in net outmigration and climate-driven changes in crop yields, with an estimated semi-elasticity of about -0.17, i.e., a 1% decrease in yields leads to a 0.17% net reduction of the population through migration. This effect is primarily driven by young adults. We do not detect a response for senior citizens, nor for the general population in eastern counties outside the Corn Belt. Applying this semi-elasticity to predicted yield changes under the B2 scenario of the Hadley III model, we project that, holding other factors constant, climate change would on average induce 3.7% of the adult population (ages 15-59) to leave rural counties of the Corn Belt in the medium term (2020-2049) compared to the 1960-1989 baseline, with the possibility of a much larger migration response in the long term (2077-2099).Since there is uncertainty about future warming, we also present projections for a range of uniform climate change scenarios in temperature or precipitation.
abstract_zh: 我们利用1970—2009年最新时期的县级面板数据，考察了美国农业生产率与净迁移之间的关系。在玉米带的农村县，我们发现净迁出变化与气候驱动的作物单产变化之间存在统计显著的关系，半弹性约为-0.17，即单产下降1%导致通过迁移造成的人口净减少0.17%。这一效应主要由年轻成年人驱动。我们未发现老年人的反应，玉米带以外东部县的总人口也未见反应。将这一半弹性应用于Hadley III模型B2情景下的预测单产变化，我们预计，在其他因素保持不变的情况下，相对于1960—1989年基准期，中期（2020—2049年）气候变化平均将促使玉米带农村县3.7%的成年人口（15至59岁）迁出。长期（2077—2099年）的迁移反应可能大得多。由于未来变暖存在不确定性，我们还给出了一系列均匀气候变化情景（温度或降水）下的预测。

title: Coase, Hotelling and Pigou: The Incidence of a Carbon Tax and CO2 Emissions
abstract: We use field-level cost estimates of all oil and natural gas fields to highlight dynamic aspects of a global carbon tax. Some of the initial reduction in consumption will be offset through higher consumption later on. Only high-cost reserves will be priced out of the market, e.g., at 200 dollars per ton of CO₂ cumulative emissions decrease by 4%. The tax incidence initially falls on consumers under a constant tax but eventually becomes negative as the lifetime of the resources is extended. An increasing tax over time reduces the initial incidence on consumers.
abstract_zh: 我们利用所有油气田的油田级成本估计，来揭示全球碳税的动态特征。最初的消费减少，将部分被后期更高的消费所抵消。只有高成本储量会被挤出市场，例如，在每吨CO₂累计排放量200美元的水平下，排放量将减少4%。在恒定税率下，税负最初由消费者承担，但随着资源寿命延长，税负最终会变为负值。随时间递增的税率会降低消费者最初承担的税负。

title: Cooling Externality of Large-Scale Irrigation
abstract: We provide novel evidence that large-scale irrigation heterogeneously shifts the temperature distribution towards cooler temperatures during the months of the growing season relative to the rest of the year. We employ a triple-difference estimator using a 59-year-long panel of weather records paired with the fraction of a county that is irrigated in 393 counties over the Ogallala aquifer. Cooling-by-irrigation propagates downwind and reduces the upper tail of the temperature distribution by up to 3C (5F) during the month of August, which has positive externalities on downwind crop yields ($120 million per year) and temperature-induced excess mortality ($240 million per year) that are of equal magnitude as the direct benefits of irrigation by enhancing heat tolerance ($440 million per year). The observed cooling helps explain why the US has seen less warming, especially of very hot temperatures, than what climate models project. Our findings highlight that weather shocks in highly irrigated areas are not exogenous but are influenced by human responses in the form of irrigation.
abstract_zh: 我们提供了新的证据，表明大规模灌溉会使生长季各月的气温分布相对于一年中其他月份向更凉爽的方向异质性地偏移。我们采用三重差分估计量，使用了393个位于奥加拉拉含水层之上的县的59年长的天气记录面板，并与各县灌溉面积比例相匹配。灌溉带来的降温沿下风向传播，并在8月份将气温分布的上尾降低多达3°C（5°F），这对下风向作物单产（每年1.2亿美元）和温度引起的超额死亡（每年2.4亿美元）产生了正外部性，其规模与灌溉通过增强耐热性带来的直接收益（每年4.4亿美元）相当。观测到的降温有助于解释，为何美国经历的变暖（尤其是极端高温的变暖）比气候模式预测的要少。我们的研究结果表明，高度灌溉地区的天气冲击并非外生的，而是受到以灌溉形式出现的人类响应的影响。

title: Empirical Tests of the Green Paradox for Climate Legislation
abstract: The Green Paradox posits that fossil fuel markets respond to changing expectations about climate legislation, which limits future consumption, by shifting consumption to the present through lower present-day prices. We demonstrate that oil futures responded negatively to daily changes in the prediction market's expectations that the Waxman-Markey bill — the US climate bill discussed in 2009-2010 — would pass. This effect is consistent across various maturities as the proposed legislation would reset the entire price and consumption path, unlike temporary supply or demand shocks that phase out over time. The bill’s passage would have increased current global oil consumption by 2-4%. Furthermore, a strengthening of climate policy, as measured by monthly variations in media salience regarding climate policy over the last four decades, and two court rulings signaling limited future fossil fuel use, were associated with negative abnormal oil future returns. Taken together, our findings confirm that restricting future fossil fuel use will accelerate current-day consumption.
abstract_zh: 绿色悖论认为，化石燃料市场会对气候立法预期的变化作出反应：由于立法将限制未来消费，市场通过降低当前价格，将消费提前到现在。我们证明，石油期货对预测市场中关于Waxman-Markey法案（2009—2010年讨论的美国气候法案）能否通过的预期的每日变化作出了负向反应。这一效应在不同到期期限中均一致，因为拟议立法将重置整个价格和消费路径，这不同于随时间逐渐消退的暂时性供给或需求冲击。该法案若获通过，将使当前全球石油消费增加2%—4%。此外，以过去四十年媒体对气候政策关注度的月度变化衡量的气候政策强化，以及两项预示未来化石燃料使用受限的法院裁决，均与石油期货的负向异常收益相关。综上，我们的研究结果证实，限制未来化石燃料使用将加速当前的消费。

title: Environmental Drivers of Agricultural Productivity Growth: CO2 Fertilization of US Field Crops
abstract: We present a novel methodology to estimate the CO2 fertilization effect on crop yields using data from NASA's Orbiting Carbon Observatory satellites. Our study complements field and chamber experiments by examining county-level crop yields under actual growing conditions across the majority of US cropland. For identification, we utilize remotely sensed, year-to-year CO2 anomalies from county-specific trends and further instrument for these anomalies using wind patterns. We find a CO2 fertilization effect greater than that reported in most field and chamber experiments. In a thought exercise, we apply the CO2 fertilization effect estimated in our sample from 2015–2022 backward to 1940. Assuming no other limiting factors, we find that rising CO2 was a major driver of past yield growth, particularly for wheat—with important implications for estimates of future climate change damages.
abstract_zh: 我们提出了一种新方法，利用美国国家航空航天局（NASA）轨道碳观测卫星（Orbiting Carbon Observatory）的数据，估计二氧化碳施肥效应对作物产量的影响。我们的研究对田间和气室试验形成补充，考察了美国大部分耕地在实际生长条件下的县级作物产量。为识别因果效应，我们利用遥感获取的、相对于各县特定趋势的逐年CO2异常值，并进一步以风场模式作为这些异常值的工具变量。我们发现，二氧化碳施肥效应大于大多数田间和气室试验的结果。在一项思想实验中，我们将2015–2022年样本估计出的CO2施肥效应向前推算至1940年。假设不存在其他限制性因素，我们发现，二氧化碳浓度上升是过去产量增长的主要驱动力，对小麦尤为明显，这对未来气候变化损失的估计具有重要意义。

title: Ground-Level Ozone and Corn Yields in the United States
Institutions and Global Crop Yields
abstract: We estimate annual discontinuities in remotely-sensed crop yields at all international land borders and link them to changes in the economic freedom index by the Fraser Institute, a country-level measure of institutional quality. Each point of the ten-point index increases the discontinuity by 2.2% over the next five years, highlighting that institutional reforms have the potential to close some of the observed crop yield gap. Three subcategories are consistently significant: credit market regulation, inflation, and the top marginal tax rate. We present suggestive evidence that higher average yields are achieved through increased use of irrigation and mechanization. Yield variability remains unchanged, and reforms lead to cropland expansion through deforestation.
abstract_zh: 我们估计了所有国际陆地边界处遥感作物单产的年度断点，并将其与弗雷泽研究所编制的经济自由度指数（一项国家层面的制度质量指标）的变化联系起来。该十分制指数每增加一分，断点在接下来五年内增加2.2%，这表明制度改革有可能缩小部分已观察到的作物产量差距。三个子类别始终显著：信贷市场监管、通货膨胀和最高边际税率。我们提供了一些提示性证据，表明较高的平均单产是通过增加灌溉和机械化的使用实现的。单产变异性保持不变，且改革导致通过毁林扩大耕地面积。

title: Optimal Exploration and Price Paths of a Non-renewable Commodity with Stochastic Discoveries
